notes: Read 2026-11-25. Every operations/highVolume row was read on the page named in url (WebFetch or a downloaded PDF extracted with pdftotext); 'value' is the page figure, or the midpoint of a published range where the unit says 'range'. Currency is left as published (USD, EUR, CNY, HUF); no FX applied. TME Hungarian site was used because its HUF prices show 2 decimals (about 3% resolution) where the GBP/USD/PLN sites round sub-penny reel prices to 0.00. TME resistors are UNI-ROYAL / Royalohm commercial-grade thick film, not AEC-Q200; they show the curve shape above 100k is shallow (0603: 0.32 HUF at 100k to 0.30 HUF at 400k, -6%; 0805: 0.46 at 100k to 0.44 at 1.2M, -4%). The Chinese EMS quotation standard (Beijing Far East Deli Electronics, Global Sources PDF, created 15 Jul 2021) is one company's internal price list, not a market survey. The Infineon TC3Ex flash figures are the device's own program/erase limits: programming time on a line = erase + program (device-limited) + communication + verify, so real cycle time is at least 1-2.2 s/MB plus erase. The JLCPCB prices are prototype/small-batch list prices.
